summary: Retest of the 5 issues from iteration 7, plus health and a Chromium 1366 regression run. Used new players qa.xc01-xc07. PASS: (1) Fair-play. In Firefox and WebKit, Esc exits fullscreen with no modal and no /events call. Tab-hidden is still counted in all 3 engines. Window blur is counted in Chromium and WebKit. In headless Firefox blur is not counted only because headless Firefox reports pointer:none (a test artefact; logic unchanged). In Chromium, Esc in the menu and in the editor keeps fullscreen and shows no modal. (2) GlossMenu: outside click closed the menu 5 of 5 times in every engine while the timer ran; Arrow keys + Enter inserted the approved term; Esc closes it in Chromium. (3) Mobile landing-signin works at 390 and 360 in all engines and opens /register?returning=1 'Welcome back' with the email field only. (4) GET and HEAD /api/health return 200 healthy. (5) Regression at 1366x768 Chromium: full Trial run, score 20, no console errors. The header passes at 768 and 820 in all engines. STILL FAILING: header at 1024x768 (all engines); /register and the returning form at 360px (all engines, card now about 30px too wide); /health returns the SPA HTML, not health JSON.

minor.issue: Returns 200 but text/html (the SPA index.html), not {status:'healthy'}. server.py only defines /api/health; /health falls through to the proxy and the web app. On the public URL the ingress sends non-/api paths to port 3000 anyway, which also serves the SPA. If an external monitor needs /health JSON, add a route in the Node API/static server for port 3000, or point the monitor at /api/health (which works: 200 JSON healthy for both GET and HEAD).

ui_bugs.issue: Still off-screen at 1024x768 in all 3 engines. At lg the nav (lg:flex) and the name/office chip (hidden lg:block) both show. The profile-menu button spans x=923-1132 on a 1024 viewport, and its dropdown spans 872-1128, so about 100px (the chevron and right side of the menu, including part of 'Sign out') is clipped. 768x1024 and 820x1180 now PASS (button 676-744 / 728-796; dropdown fully visible; the Leaderboard item navigates). 1366 PASS.

NOT fixed; it is worse (about 30px overflow; it was 9px). At 360x740 the form.card spans x=16-389 and the H1 'Enlist for the challenge', all inputs, the textarea and the Listen button (297-373) are clipped on the right. The returning 'Welcome back' email input and the 'Your Rewards Journey' panel (50 UP TO CREDITS) are clipped too. RCA: the parent `div.grid.lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_1fr].gap-6` has no explicit column template below lg, so its implicit auto track is 373.6px (the min-content of a child) while the container is 328px. min-w-0 on the form cannot shrink an implicit auto track. Fix: add `grid-cols-1` (repeat(1,minmax(0,1fr))) to that grid div, or min-w-0 on all its grid children, including the rewards panel. 390px renders fine (16-390 but within the viewport, so there is no right gutter).

action_items: Register.tsx: add `grid-cols-1` to the outer `grid lg:grid-cols-[1.1fr_1fr] gap-6` wrapper (or min-w-0 on every child) so the card and the rewards panel fit 360px. Check both the enlist and the returning (?returning=1) views.

Optional: add a real /health JSON route if a monitor needs it (today it returns SPA HTML); /api/health is fine.

critical_code_review_comments: useFairPlay fs handler: the early return when navigator.keyboard.lock is missing is correct. Note that it also stops counting a deliberate fullscreen exit via F11 or the browser UI in Firefox/Safari; tab and blur still catch real departures. Blur counting depends on matchMedia('(pointer: fine)'), so touch-only and pointer:none devices never count blur (by design).

GlossMenu: the latest-ref pattern with an effect that runs once (deps []) is correct, and the outside-click flake is gone. Minor: the effect closes over the `base` menu only through refs. If the same GlossMenu instance is reused for a new term without remounting, `hi` is not reset (it was not observed).
